messages:
maria_ops: Heads up - APAC cluster running low on spare H100s, holding ~40% of scheduled training capacity. GreenBox just replied with 8-10 week lead time for a fresh lease top-up. Need an interim plan.

sam_sourcing: @maria_ops is that the GreenBox shipment ETA? any chance to split or expedite?

tom_vendor: Hey team (GreenBox) — we can offer a split fulfillment: 6 units air (4-5 wk) + remainder sea (8-10 wk). Air carries +18% freight premium and IOR handling. We can also loan EU-pool units (short notice) but that risks extra transit/customs time.

maria_ops: Can you itemize the delta on costs for air vs loaners? Also how RMA will work if we swap loaners into our environment — need depot handover details for equipment checks.

tom_vendor: Air split: ~$32k incremental for 6 H100s (freight + customs expedite + broker). EU loaner option: ~$12k handling + potential duty exposure unless temporary import docs are used. Depot in SIN (SentraDepot) will do serial audit + firmware verification on intake.

li-ana_logistics: SentraDepot intake SLA is 48h after arrival if paperwork is correct. Last month they held a batch for 5 days due to manifest mismatch. They require consolidated AWB + detailed invoice with SKU/serial list.

maria_ops: Manifest mismatch is a killer. @sam_sourcing can legal sign off on 'temporary import/loaner' invoice language to avoid duties? We want no surprises.

sam_sourcing: Looping in legal_bot for tariff wording. Also confirm whether SentraDepot needs kitting/packaging spec — last return had foam damage and they rejected acceptance.

legal_bot: Suggested invoice text: 'Temporary loan for evaluation/operation under existing MSA; no transfer of ownership; goods to be re-exported.' Recommend noting HS code for temporary imports. Please confirm with broker.

maria_ops: If we go air-split, what's ETA from pickup to depot handover in SIN? Tom?

tom_vendor: If docs are clean, air pickup -> depot handover in 5 business days. We'll provide AWB + commercial invoice + packing list and CSV manifest.

akira_ops: Quick infra note — losing 10 H100s drops our priority training throughput by ~40% unless we throttle batch jobs. Can we temporarily move some workloads to TPU nodes to reduce impact?

maria_ops: We'll throttle non-critical batches and re-prioritize. That gives us ~72 hours breathing room but we need loaners asap.

tom_vendor: RMA process note: if units arrive DOA or with firmware mismatch, SentraDepot will open an RMA manifest. We can arrange same-day re-export on replacement under warranty but there is an RMA processing fee (~$300/unit) if special handling required.

li-ana_logistics: To avoid rework: provide CSV with columns: sku, serial_number, model, firmware_version. SentraDepot will reject intake if firmware_version is blank. Also include 'temporary_import' flag.

maria_ops: Sam, can you confirm budget for the $32k air premium? We need decision by EOD.

sam_sourcing: I can allocate up to $25k from sourcing reserves. Maria, would infra cover the remaining $7k?

maria_ops: Infra approves $7k. Proceed with the air split for 6 units and SentraDepot handover. Tom, please schedule pickup and share AWB + manifest ASAP. Mark docs 'temporary import - loaner' to reduce duty risks.

tom_vendor: Copy. Scheduling pickup tomorrow morning. Will send AWB + manifest CSV and commercial invoice. Requesting priority intake with SentraDepot. Expect AWB/manifest by 1923520000.

akira_ops: Thanks — I'll prepare the throttle plan and post details to #eng-runtime. Will coordinate cutover windows. :thumbsup:

maria_ops: One more intake instruction: if SentraDepot reports firmware mismatch on arrival, quarantine devices and DO NOT power on until we confirm with fw team. Add that to the intake notes.

tom_vendor: Noted. We'll add quarantine + 'no power' instruction to the intake. SentraDepot ops contact: +65-6000-1234.

li-ana_logistics: Added quarantine and contact to the manifest checklist. I'll monitor customs/broker queue and ping if they request additional docs.

maria_ops: Final decision recorded: air-split 6 units, EU loaner route avoided, costs split ($32k vendor additional, infra $7k). Proceeding.

ops-bot: Action created: 'APAC-air-topup-1923456789' assigned to tom_vendor, due 1923520000.
